verdict.rationale: The evidence lists 'Digital offer letters & eSignatures' and 'Pre-onboarding & Onboarding' as feature headings, but nothing documents HRIS or payroll integrations that carry a hired candidate's data across without re-entry. The webhooks and candidate API are developer building blocks a team could use to build such a sync, not the integration itself. The onboarding mention is an adjacent feature heading with no described handoff of offer or new-hire data.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
